requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/parseQuery.js` and your own tests in `tests/parseQuery.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `parseQuery(qs)` parsing a query string (optional leading '?') into an object: percent-decoded keys and values, '+' means space, a repeated key becomes an array in order, a key without '=' has value ''. Empty input gives {}.
